name: branding-black-and-white-hands-eye-frame-luxury-cover
title: Black-and-white hands forming a frame around eyes, with a serif 'Maison Noire' title
whatItIs: A black cover with a greyscale photo of two hands forming a triangular frame each with an eye in the palm, a flourished serif title 'MAISON NOIRE' in the middle and tiny credits and columns of text at the sides.
whatItMeans: Mysterious and elegant; the eye-in-hand image sets a fashion-noir tone.
techniques: Use a surreal black-and-white photo as the central image.
Place tiny credits in the corners.
Add faint text columns at the sides.
bestFor: Cover slides with a striking image

vocabulary.definition: Faint text running down the edges.
